title: Massage Therapist Appointment Reminder
problem_statement: Solo massage therapists lose significant income to last-minute no-shows and forgotten appointments. The tool must automate SMS reminders for clients to reduce missed sessions.
target_user: Massage/bodywork solo practitioners looking to minimize no-shows and maximize appointment attendance
core_requirements: Automated SMS reminder system triggered 24 hours before session time
User-friendly interface for therapists to input client information and preferences
Template customization options for reminder messages
Integration with existing calendar/scheduling software (if applicable)
Reporting feature to track no-shows and appointment history
success_criteria: Reduction in no-show appointments by at least 30%
Positive feedback from therapists using the system
Easy setup process with minimal training required
Integration capabilities meet or exceed market standards
